About

I like figuring out how the pieces fit together.

I work with Java, Python, and C, and build web applications with React and Node.js. I’m interested in what happens behind an interface: how an API handles a request, how data moves through a system, and how software stays useful as it grows.

Through coursework, projects, and hackathons, I’ve practiced building, debugging, and collaborating under deadlines. I’m also reading papers and connecting with professors about research in algorithms, machine learning, data science, and backend systems.

Outside of code, I follow basketball and finance, and enjoy video games and poker.
